_comment: Replaces Minecraft's pixel font everywhere: menus, chat, signs, books,
item names, and this mod's own screens.
Open Sans, taken from googlefonts/opensans rather than google/fonts.
The latter now ships this family only as a variable font, and Minecraft's
font loader drops those without a word - which is what happened with Inter
and made it look as though nothing had been installed. This file is a
static TrueType with plain glyf outlines, which is what the loader reads.
Order matters. Providers listed later win, so the vanilla includes stay
first as a fallback and the TrueType entry sits last to take priority.
Keeping include/default is what stops Chinese, Japanese and Korean text
from turning into boxes - Open Sans has no glyphs for them.
If the text sits too high or too low, change shift. If it looks too big
or too small next to the interface, change size.
